Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 100, "heading": "VII COSETTE CÔTE À CÔTE DANS L’OMBRE AVEC L’INCONNU", "previous_rows": [], "source_language": "French", "part": 2, "book": 3, "chapter": 7, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u100-h", "tag": "heading", "text": "VII COSETTE CÔTE À CÔTE DANS L’OMBRE AVEC L’INCONNU", "sha256": "e751f7811b281ed5f61e353c4111a00c428af97f76959f5be7d50d7f0ce97c30", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0001", "tag": "prose", "text": "Cosette, nous l’avons dit, n’avait pas eu peur.", "sha256": "f257a26b07e9b4e7edcd5fc087c486fc60059ae2b44b9c96b8cb0ff109c5e0c5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0002", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme lui adressa la parole. Il parlait d’une voix grave et presque basse.", "sha256": "836d8b7699ebb3940bd3cb789787bf61b19cb3fdf13e09b13c94e31ed4207608", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0003", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mon enfant, c’est bien lourd pour vous ce que vous portez là.", "sha256": "34caa9bed73dd5b2904d659ccfbdcac2ac20d5c80ea1cff36eb178993e1c49bd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0004", "tag": "prose", "text": "Cosette leva la tête et répondit :", "sha256": "14031c1b987a4fbed9d1d9ee28b2e07eadf3261ce109178aeb7c634153757318", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0005", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, monsieur.", "sha256": "0d5465ec58ffd8a169046d0b5a9216b597e575402307c2d51b58ce3a1f4a288b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0006", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Donnez, reprit l’homme, je vais vous le porter.", "sha256": "94c3691f60bb61533e19c3e8d6ac21ba997621e7f4c8e18b580cc941ec80463d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0007", "tag": "prose", "text": "Cosette lâcha le seau. L’homme se mit à cheminer près d’elle.", "sha256": "e685b944ed5dbdc685fb4c82c40a9f6a8608695c47f6d9b0246ba4d323127878", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0008", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est très lourd, en effet, dit-il entre ses dents. Puis il ajouta :", "sha256": "866700a9e518222df7e87e729ac36aed9d92df385e673805d71a54ce6b5a2b65", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0009", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Petite, quel âge as-tu ?", "sha256": "25ce939ab7a61b2189b69304cf441e667ea114fa8addf4fde3d8be9be6d941a4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0010", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Huit ans, monsieur.", "sha256": "6abccdaeb0d5bc7128747c5c815302b5baaad16145932b8aa8288d089f4836fd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0011", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et viens-tu de loin comme cela ?", "sha256": "558b45793404049fe6bff153c56750a9b2703b6dfa3d467e2bbb187658d80fd2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0012", "tag": "prose", "text": "— De la source qui est dans le bois.", "sha256": "9528d99cb006af77fd6a0600ef9d26ca71ad24223878a372a928c8143500c642", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0013", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et est-ce loin où tu vas ?", "sha256": "0d4a800260032e0b46e9a63034f81e780deec0c266434cb4b3c3c99a2aec0f88", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0014", "tag": "prose", "text": "— À un bon quart d’heure d’ici.", "sha256": "4bb6c8ff3f4984d0bcb1298d75077b6a01f4e819c6dbf0804cc63b5eccb76b8b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0015", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme resta un moment sans parler, puis il dit brusquement :", "sha256": "0ad7dc301facb7e101fee3c00409ec153077c9edde27ebec538cf92b9ac0f580", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0016", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tu n’as donc pas de mère ?", "sha256": "ed5f2468fd421f8bbaf01df4d5dcf56579b519619fd0b3b6fbc58b30fa0922c0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0017", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ne sais pas, répondit l’enfant.", "sha256": "33e845cbeda87936bf218979b2fedd643553114b72e535f6cd66b26cb60ebb00", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0018", "tag": "prose", "text": "Avant que l’homme eût eu le temps de reprendre la parole, elle ajouta :", "sha256": "7b73cb3e1efaef2f4fd83f523c8102d058296dc3b1b9b40d9c64bb074fb0e55e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0019", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ne crois pas. Les autres en ont. Moi, je n’en ai pas.", "sha256": "989c0852858c68355083031e463fa389e5cfa57646d9f1bf502ed4796f91d96f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0020", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et après un silence, elle reprit :", "sha256": "90232dc9a645cab51241f2e88c9cc85304e42204c5010bb6c45ee8dd7cd2c83e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0021", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je crois que je n’en ai jamais eu.", "sha256": "466edf0b8354f14b9849336c83e326b665a05907f3c098c3add75b39723cd31c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0022", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme s’arrêta, il posa le seau à terre, se pencha et mit ses deux mains sur les deux épaules de l’enfant, faisant effort pour la regarder et voir son visage dans l’obscurité.", "sha256": "af5d595fe729fea3b6bc44b2f9d84273b82e87da9e69d2bf5b61b15c71e6c35f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0023", "tag": "prose", "text": "La figure maigre et chétive de Cosette se dessinait vaguement à la lueur livide du ciel.", "sha256": "fb422d1e06bdf5487127a6d54b9b07baeadcf9e830fd041fa13f9be3aa6a5d66", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0024", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comment t’appelles-tu ?", "sha256": "f852aa85ea3496e775461dbf147174dfdf0a4cdfc5faf9b035caeeb6ec123b9e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0025", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Cosette.", "sha256": "fac6c5bda5e83ed048bf777d46cbc35133071df9a8cb9e9ac3ac9206f7f4caa7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0026", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme eut comme une secousse électrique. Il la regarda encore, puis il ôta ses mains de dessus les épaules de Cosette, saisit le seau, et se remit à marcher.", "sha256": "d62e63b97021f1b618a4bbf016b8d901fb59df9c3e1babc4d54d6ef233e9dd47", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0027", "tag": "prose", "text": "Au bout d’un instant, il demanda :", "sha256": "c6d0c5b6f2fb1a640fb5b8093de2efcd0466bdf60247da0bf1d9b5dd882dc3a4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0028", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Petite, où demeures-tu ?", "sha256": "5d9dcbaf8052a418d2a8b8ba99a2389f7d84f6386dbdd0bdcbab01aa3791a650", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0029", "tag": "prose", "text": "— À Montfermeil, si vous connaissez.", "sha256": "956ea9eb703e6c0693c2857d6c01df22716f7b142591d9394acc22407ad3a0a7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0030", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est là que nous allons ?", "sha256": "a6392ba940d4506bdc77717ff26a1ebee40c1f0ecf6614dad2ebf793c1e6cd0f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u100-r0031", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, monsieur.", "sha256": "0d5465ec58ffd8a169046d0b5a9216b597e575402307c2d51b58ce3a1f4a288b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
